exercises.title: A moving average
exercises.task: Read MovingAverage: keep the sum of the window; when it slides, add the value that enters and subtract the one that leaves. Run compares its number of additions with recomputing each window from scratch.

exercises.title: A rate limiter
exercises.task: Allow at most limit requests in any window of window seconds. The limiter keeps the times of the requests it allowed in a queue. Fill Allow: first drop the times that have left the window, then decide.
hints: A time t has left the window at now when t <= now - window. The oldest times are at the front of the queue.
Drop from the front while the front is too old: for len(l.times) > 0 && ….
Then: if fewer than limit times remain, append now and return true; otherwise return false (a refused request is not recorded).

exercises.title: The longest run without a repeat
exercises.task: In a stream of request IDs, find the longest run of consecutive requests with no ID repeated (useful to spot retry storms). Return its start and length. A window that grows on the right and shrinks on the left: each ID enters once and leaves once, O(n).
hints: Keep a map from ID to its last position. Move right one step at a time.
If the ID at right was last seen at a position ≥ left, it is a repeat inside the window: move left just past that position.
After each step, the window is [left, right]: keep the longest one (the earliest, on a tie).
